Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created INC-0001 "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy" documenting the failure and the rollback. (The first request timed out, but the incident was created successfully.)
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The first rollback attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. I retried the rollback, which then completed across all regions.

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on **v2.3.0** in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), **healthy** with error rate 0.002. Incident INC-0001 remains open for the on-call engineer to follow up on.
